description: Use this when someone arrives in Cartagena, Colombia on a cruise ship for the day and wants to know what fits between arrival and all aboard: the fortress Castillo San Felipe only inside its cool windows, the walled-city loop while the streets are cool, lunch and the museums through the hot hours, the city wall at sunset, and the latest start back to the terminal. Give arrival and all-aboard times, or a ship and date from the 2026-27 schedule; taxi or walking in, and the buffers, can be changed. Returns every step with clock times, the hot steps marked with the felt temperature, and a one-line summary, and shows a timeline card. Not for a land stay of a day or more. Examples: "Our ship docks in Cartagena at 8:00 and all aboard is 17:30. What can we do?" / "Llegamos en crucero a Cartagena a las 7:00, ¿nos da tiempo para el Castillo San Felipe?"

all_aboard.description: All-aboard time as HH:MM; after midnight, e.g. 00:30, counts as the next day. Default: from the ship, or the common call.

arrival.description: Ship arrival as HH:MM (24-hour). Default: the most common arrival of the season.

ashore_min.description: Minutes to get off the ship and through the terminal (default 45).

back_min.description: Minutes to be back at the terminal before all aboard (default 30).

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (or "today", "tomorrow"), 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31. With ship, picks that call; alone, lists the ships in port.

language.description: Language of the wording: en, es, de, fr, it, pt, ru, nl. Match the user; for any other language use en and translate. Facts, numbers and links are the same in every language.

mode.description: Into town by taxi (default) or on foot.

month.description: Month 1 to 12. Default: the current month in Cartagena.

ship.description: Ship name from the 2026-27 schedule of single-day calls, e.g. "MSC Seaview". Needs date or month.

taxi_min.description: Minutes for one taxi ride door to door (default 20).

name: cruise_day_ashore
title: Cartagena cruise day planner
